title: Formal Coherence Proof of ΔT Framework
abstract: Rigorous mathematical proof that the ΔT number system is coherent, consistent, and adjoinable to existing mathematics

axioms.name: Well-Definedness
axioms.statement: ∀x ∈ domain: Δt(x) is uniquely defined and finite

axioms.name: Transformation Potential
axioms.statement: θ function activates based on accumulated resolution

base_invariance.statement: The Δt function maintains structural invariance across base conversions

proof_steps.justification: Definition of Δt as measurement resolution ratio
Both numerator and unit scale by same factor

proof_steps.mathematical_form: Δt_b(x) = c × Δt_10(f(x)) where c is conversion factor
proof_steps.justification: Direct computation shows invariance
Fundamental property of digit-based measurement

additive_coherence.statement: Δt respects the additive structure of rational numbers

proof_steps.justification: Direct consequence of digit ordering in place value system
Resolution of sum cannot be less than difference of resolutions
Common denominator analysis shows consistent behavior

multiplicative_coherence.statement: Δt respects the multiplicative structure of rational numbers

proof_steps.mathematical_form: Δt(k × x) = k^α × Δt(x) for integer k
proof_steps.justification: Multiplication affects both numerator and denominator proportionally

proof_steps.mathematical_form: Δt(x^n) = n × Δt(x) for natural numbers n
proof_steps.justification: Exponentiation compounds digit patterns predictably
Cross-multiplication maintains resolution patterns

continuity_properties.statement: Δt is discontinuous at rational boundaries but predictable

proof_steps.justification: Crossing base power boundaries changes digit structure
Jump magnitude follows geometric progression
Only countable set of base power boundaries

adjoinability.statement: ΔT extends rather than contradicts existing mathematical structures

proof_steps.description: Compatibility with decimal place value theory
proof_steps.justification: Direct extension of elementary decimal analysis

proof_steps.mathematical_form: v_p(x) related to Δt(x) for p = base
proof_steps.justification: Both measure "closeness" to zero in different metrics

proof_steps.mathematical_form: Δt of convergentents bounds approximation quality
proof_steps.justification: Better convergents have more structured Δt values
Δt measures digit structure complexity

integration_coherence.statement: The integral component extends analytically to continuous domain

proof_steps.justification: Polynomial integrand guarantees analyticity
Heaviside step function maintains linearity on positive domain

proof_steps.mathematical_form: lim_{n→∞} ∫_0^5 f_n(x-b) dx = ∫_0^5 lim f_n(x-b) dx
proof_steps.justification: Dominated convergence theorem applies

completeness.title: Completeness and Consistency of ΔT System

consistency.verification: All test cases evaluate to finite real numbers

completeness.statement: ΔT system is complete for its domain
completeness.justification: All operations within domain produce valid results

categorical.statement: ΔT forms a category with meaningful morphisms
